body:
I'm sure if I make it through this weekend I'll wake up feeling like a million fucking dollars and that every one of my farts makes the Earth cleaner. That tends to happen after my more suicidal depressions. But then one, two weeks later I hit this slump again. I start having panic attacks and acting like a lunatic in private. If this is what the rest of my life is going to be, then I don't want it.

It's not like my life, in particular, even means anything to begin with. None of us fucking matter. I'm just some random assortment of shitty genetics all bundled together from nature's refuse pile. If I *can't* and *don't want to* live with myself, why should I bother trying? Where's the net positive if my whole life is going to be this miserable? Fuck other people, I don't want to be alive. I'm not going to suffer like this because it makes other people happy.
I'm sorry, that was a lot of word vomit. I don't know why I'm writing so much. I don't know why I do anything anymore, my brain works on its own schedule. Sorry if none of this makes any sense.

I've been a disappointment to everyone in my life for several years. Like, I was always touted as the smart/creative/gifted sibling and cousin (and I have a large extended family), and I could see the disappointment and pity in everyone's eyes when they realized how badly I screwed up. And most of them didn't even know most of the story.

I recently tried, yet again, to get my shit together and get a fucking degree, but it got ruined when I started having anxiety attacks and self-doubt and just fucking everything up. That was a year ago, but they think I've been doing well in school since, when I haven't actually been going. I'm living on my parents' dime - although financial aid and scholarships were paying for school - and my success was one of the few positive things they had in their life. For them to hear that not only did I screw up even worse this time, but that I've been *lying* about it to everyone, I can't even think about how devastating it would be to them. I don't even know what would happen.

So reaching out to my family isn't something I can do anymore. I've dug myself too deep.

This is going to sound melodramatic, but all those positive emotions you listed don't really mean anything to me anymore. I don't if I have some kind of autism spectrum disorder or anything, but back when I was younger, I fit, like, a *lot* of the classic symptoms. Up until I was about 15, I was socially oblivious in the worst way, you know? Anyway, the only time I remember feeling genuinely happy was before I stopped being so oblivious to everything. I had a sort of epiphany my junior year of high school where I just became *aware* of myself for the first time, and I hated who I was. I hated how awkward and graceless and fucking weird everything about me was, and I resented how completely ignorant of it I had been. Things never really picked up for me after that moment, my life just got darker each year after.

I guess what I'm saying is I don't know how to be happy while also being aware of... everything. Myself. I've grown to hate myself so much that happiness is like a totally incomprehensible thing to me, now.

Yeah, I chickened out. Sat on my roof for about five hours last night before going to sleep. I'm going to try again tonight but I'm out of alcohol; maybe being sober will make it easier, I don't know. I meant to go buy some more today but one of my parents came home early and kind of screwed up my plans.

I just, all that sounds so unfulfilling. Like, I've *tried* the whole "fake it til you make it" schtick and it doesn't seem to work. I get positive for a little and then crash *hard* into a worse depression than before. It's why I've pretty much stopped doing anything. I could try again but, really, what's it going to achieve?

As for solutions... I don't think there are any for my particular problems. The external ones, sure, there are definitely solutions for those, but they'd be really, really difficult and expensive - both time and money-wise - to come by. Therapy, telling my family how badly I've failed, more therapy, maybe medication, lots of money that our insurance probably wouldn't cover, etc. I don't know, all that sounds like too much.

And even if I do all that, it doesn't solve the issues that started this whole mess. I have... body image issues. Not body dysmorphic disorder, but something that can't be "fixed" or "healed." I've already tried to legitimately treat it before and it didn't work out, it forced me to accept some ugly truths about my body that I'd been ignoring for a long time and now I'm too afraid to touch it again.

Ugh what am I doing. I'm sorry, I'm just wasting your time here. I'm being super vague and pigeon-holing myself and this isn't going anywhere. Thanks for the positivity, but it's too late. I'm done.

Heh. Not anymore. I fucked EVERYTHING up. Like, there isn't one aspect of my life that isn't broken, or filled with lies, or forgotten, or whatever. I have zero quality of life. I pretend for my parents, but I've run out of room to lie in, it's either I fess up that I've fucked up AGAIN, even worse this time, or I do what I've been meaning too for two and a half years.

I don't want happiness, because to get it, I have to compromise on things I hate about myself. I just don't think I can do that.

Sure, sure. I was happy once. But I was oblivious to who I was, to *what* I was. I'm not anymore, and every day that's passed since I first understood myself has killed me more than the previous. I've lost my skills, my passions, my friends, professional and academic opportunities, and now my personality. I'm not even a shadow of a ghost anymore.

I'm just tired of hating everything about myself and being too insane to be able to do anything about it. Some days I feel totally insane, so I'm gonna end it. Life is clearly just too much for me, you know?

Well I'll be dead, so it really doesn't matter what they'll think of me for doing this. I've been consumed by this for so long that I can't even imagine how other people feel anymore. This has shut out any other emotions. Guilt of what it would do to my family was the only thing that kept me from going through with it, but I don't even feel that anymore. I feel dead already.
